description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice Calling for Claims to Property of Intestate D/S Division, Moratuwa
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The content focuses on land title registration and property claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
